notes.title: MovieMator Video Editor V3.0.0 Updated!
notes.notes:
V3.0.0 Change Log:
1 Add audio recording tool
2 Add resources of music and sound
3 Simplify video export settings
4 Enable Easing Function setting for keyframe animation
5 Newly-designed user interface
6 Add fast cutting feature for videos

notes.title: New Version 2.6.4 Updated
notes.notes:
1. Solved the frame rate bugs which caused time shorten, frame loss, black screen, etc during video exporting.
2. Text Optimization: More preset text animation; Text HTML supported, etc.
3. Undo, redo function optimization.
4. Filter optimization.
5. Improve interface for easier operation.
6. Solved the problem that "Moviemator can not be used in Mac10.10.4 system".
